scripts.install:all: npm run install:client && npm run install:server
scripts.build:server:public: rm -rf server/public && mkdir -p server/public && cp -R client/babaShop/dist/. server/public/
scripts.verify:server:public: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const p=path.join(process.cwd(),'server','public','index.html'); if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('Missing built frontend:', p); process.exit(1)} console.log('Verified built frontend:', p)"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:client && npm run build:server:public
scripts.start:prod-local: sh -c 'npm run build:client && npm run build:server:public && npm run verify:server:public && npm --prefix server run dev'
